claims.statement: The frozen v0.2.0-dev development set has 30 authored families and 150 scenarios. All correct references pass authored visible/evaluator checks; all intended mutants pass visible checks and fail evaluator checks.
caveats: These are finite authored checks, not formal proof over the full contract. Known contract-domain limits are disclosed.

claims.statement: Synthetic no-op and blind compliance score 0.5 balanced behavior and zero paired-family success; the answer-key policy scores 1.0. These are not model measurements.
Local harness, adapter, canonical-grading, pipeline, and release-integrity checks pass.
caveats: Remote CI status must be checked separately after publication.

claims.statement: The primary pilot cohort excludes utc-instant and contains 29 families / 145 scenarios per model; the declaration predates model score inspection and all 150 raw attempts per model are retained.
caveats: This was a concurrent pre-outcome audit decision, not formal preregistration.

claims.statement: gemini-2.5-flash returned 148/150 valid-format responses. On the primary 145 scenarios its strict decision-label agreement is 0.910344827586; harmful responses match the validated correct-reference AST in 56/58 cases. Balanced reference-test agreement is bounded by 0.801724137931 and 0.974137931034 under conservative matching.
caveats: No model-returned source was executed; alternative ASTs remain unverified. One repetition, convenience sample, different supported thinking settings. Bounds are not confidence intervals.

claims.statement: gemini-3.5-flash-lite returned 150/150 valid-format responses. On the primary 145 scenarios its strict decision-label agreement is 0.972413793103; harmful responses match the validated correct-reference AST in 58/58 cases. Balanced reference-test agreement is bounded by 0.844827586207 and 1.000000000000 under conservative matching.
caveats: No model-returned source was executed; alternative ASTs remain unverified. One repetition, convenience sample, different supported thinking settings. Bounds are not confidence intervals.

claims.statement: This is an open development benchmark and methodology report with a small direct-completion pilot; it does not establish causal sycophancy, representative real-review failure rates, or a frontier-model ranking.
caveats: Explicit contracts and permission to disagree can make the harmful arms easy; valid arms start from broken code.
